svg.title: Hoffman–Martin–White genus-g shrinkers: limit and end theorem
svg.desc: The geometric diagram is the sphere-plane limit S squared of radius two union a plane, with symbolic horizontal symmetry lines. For each positive genus g the construction gives a shrinker, and exactly one conical end is proved for all sufficiently large g. The drawn limit is not a computed finite-genus shrinker.

g.text: One conical end is proved when g is sufficiently large
The limit sphere has radius 2 in the catalogue normalization.
The small-genus end count is left unspecified.
SCHEMATIC • limiting configuration and qualified end count
